text: Choose the word that best fills the blank: The sun rises in the east and ___ in the west. It gives us light and heat.
explanation: The sun rises in one direction and sets in the opposite one, so sets fits.

text: Choose the word that best fills the blank: Regular exercise not only keeps the body healthy ___ also sharpens the mind.
explanation: The pair is not only ... but also, so but is the correct word.

text: Choose the word that best fills the blank: Ravi worked hard all year; ___, he passed with distinction.
explanation: His success is a result of his hard work, so the connector of result, therefore, fits.

text: Choose the word that best fills the blank: She wanted to buy a car, ___ she did not have enough money.
explanation: The two parts contrast, since she wanted a car but could not afford it, so but is correct.

text: Choose the word that best fills the blank: The office remains open ___ Monday to Friday.
explanation: A range of days is written as from ... to ..., so from is correct.

text: Choose the word that best fills the blank: He was very tired; ___, he finished the work before leaving.
explanation: Finishing the work is the opposite of what tiredness would suggest, so nevertheless fits. Therefore would show a result.
